citation.authors: Mizelman E, Shaw KA, Kaviani M, Brenna E et al

cited_by.title: Bovine colostrum supplements for immunity and gut health

record.population: Club-level rugby players (26 men, 3 women), 8 weeks
record.design: Randomised, double-blind trial of bovine colostrum 38 g a day against soy protein
record.finding: Vertical jump height rose by about 1 cm with colostrum and fell by 0.5 cm with soy (p = 0.0023). There were no differences in upper or lower body strength, aerobic power, body composition, saliva immune markers or reported illness.
record.note: A small trial in athletes. Ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
